preregistration.commit_message: Preregister M0 Step 3f1 two-lane architecture screen

frozen_historical_results.manifest_18_scope: Historical combined standard-kernel WHFast physical+tangent/continuous-MEGNO configuration only.

common_physical_contract.targets: target_seconds = sample_index * 146100 * 21600; integer step counts only

P.responsibility: candidate canonical physical trajectory for architecture screening only
P.callback_accounting: Two lazy-kernel acceleration evaluations per step, 32 order-17 corrector evaluations at first map entry, and 32 inverse-corrector evaluations at each of 100 positive-time output synchronizations.
P.diagnostic_copy: Read the synchronized inertial particle representation from a simulation copy; never synchronize or rebuild the live internal map for diagnostics.

T.responsibility: native first-variation, MEGNO, and finite-time LCN diagnostics
T.callback_accounting: One standard-kernel additional-force evaluation per step; the MEGNO-only gravity variation refresh does not call additional_forces.
T.diagnostic_copy: Read the synchronized inertial particle and first-variation representation from a simulation copy; preserve the live internal map.

tangent_reuse_decision.reason: Historical lane used safe_mode=1 and keep_unsynchronized=0; the preregistered Lane T uses safe_mode=0 and keep_unsynchronized=1. These are material effective settings, so the prefix is not contract-identical.
tangent_reuse_decision.historical_lane_role: One-factor synchronization control only; never treated as an identical-contract reuse.

step3f0_source_contract.variation_kernel_constraint: REBOUND 4.6.0 reb_integrator_whfast_init rejects nonstandard kernels when native variations are present.
step3f0_source_contract.tangent_sync_behavior: reb_integrator_whfast_step temporarily synchronizes x/v/a for continuous MEGNO and restores p_jh with safe_mode=0, keep_unsynchronized=1.
step3f0_source_contract.live_map_behavior: reb_integrator_whfast_synchronize copies and restores p_jh and leaves is_synchronized=0 when keep_unsynchronized=1.
step3f0_source_contract.corrector_behavior: Order-17 correctors are supported for Jacobi coordinates; inverse correctors construct output coordinates during synchronization.
step3f0_source_contract.lazy_force_behavior: The lazy kernel invokes reb_simulation_update_acceleration for both its normal and recalculated kick, so the validated arbitrary position-only callback participates in both evaluations.
step3f0_source_contract.archive_behavior: SimulationArchive serializes WHFast fields, particles, p_jh, variations, and MEGNO without forcing synchronization; function pointers require reattachment.

reference_contract.timestamps: 101 exact stored samples at 100-year cadence; no interpolation or resampling

comparison_definitions.matching: Match all 101 samples by exact integer sample index, exact step count, time_seconds, and time_years; no interpolation.
comparison_definitions.physical_scaling: Equal weight for every selected epoch, real body, and six Cartesian components; positions divided by AU and velocities by AU/JulianYear.
comparison_definitions.per_body_contribution: Body sum of six scaled squared defects divided by the global sum over the identical epochs.
comparison_definitions.rtn: Heliocentric left-minus-right state projected into the right/reference lane R,T,N basis at each epoch.
comparison_definitions.phase_alignment: Report raw, shared-mean-anomaly, and shared-mean-longitude reconstructions using the right/reference phase; neither stripped representation is selected after inspection.
comparison_definitions.orbital_elements: Repository J2000-ecliptic heliocentric osculating elements with G*(M_sun+M_body), principal wrapped angular differences, and fixed initial semimajor-axis denominator.
comparison_definitions.nonsingular: Use eccentricity vector, unit angular-momentum vector, k=e*cos(varpi), h=e*sin(varpi), p=tan(i/2)*sin(Omega), and q=tan(i/2)*cos(Omega).
comparison_definitions.windows: Ten fixed windows, each containing (w*1000, (w+1)*1000] years; cumulative endpoints are 1000 through 10000 years.
comparison_definitions.persistent_failure: The same essential metric exceeds its threshold in at least three consecutive windows with right endpoints at or after 5000 years.
comparison_definitions.secular_frequency: NAFF-lite Hann-windowed complex FFT with three-bin log-power refinement on z_e and z_i; flag unresolved when below two Fourier bins or above 0.8 Nyquist.
comparison_definitions.mercury_perihelion: Centered unweighted OLS of unwrapped longitude of perihelion over 0-10000 years with standard-error and 95-percent interval; pair differences are screened but absolute rate is unresolved when its interval exceeds the pair threshold.
comparison_definitions.energy: Recompute E_corrected=E_Newtonian-(3*s*G^2*M_sun^2/c^2)*sum(m_i/r_i_sun^2) from state rows; report max, RMS, p99, endpoint, centered OLS trend, and ten windows.
comparison_definitions.angular_momentum: Recompute the Cartesian total angular-momentum vector and relative norm drift from state rows.
comparison_definitions.tangent: Use AU and AU/JulianYear scaling, full-system direction cosine/discrepancy, scaled norm, log growth, and relative norm difference.
comparison_definitions.lcn: Compare finite-time LCN after multiplication by 10000 years so the difference is dimensionless.

lane_p_vs_ias15.basis: Ten times the qualified componentwise IAS15 phase envelope, with the historical 5e-10 per-body pointwise floor. This is a screen threshold, not a production threshold.

lane_t_carrier_vs_ias15_and_lane_p.basis: The frozen 0.5-day versus 0.25-day 10-kyr WHFast discrepancy scale from Manifest 16; raw Cartesian phase is not the sole veto.

all_physical_pairs.basis: Ten times Manifest 16's frozen IAS15 nonphase/orientation scales, while retaining Manifest 10's Mercury-rate threshold.

tangent_sync_control.physical_per_body_rule: max(10*IAS15 per-body envelope, 0.1*historical old-tangent-vs-IAS15 per-body RMS)
tangent_sync_control.basis: Frozen Manifest 10 tangent/MEGNO/LCN gates; the direction RMS is the discrepancy implied by cosine 0.9999 and log-norm is a scale-free screen-only extension.

unresolved_metric_policy.secular_frequency_and_absolute_perihelio: Known before integration to be resolution-limited at 10 kyr and 100-year cadence; report estimates and uncertainty but treat them as contextual, nonessential metrics.
unresolved_metric_policy.essential_metrics: Physical scaled state, coordinate-free/nonsingular histories, conservation, Lane T tangent/MEGNO/LCN continuity, carrier consistency, integrity, and restart closure.

classification_rules.TWO_LANE_ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORTED: All integrity/restart checks pass; Lane P passes every essential physical, nonphase, conservation, and secular-history screen; Lane T passes tangent/MEGNO/LCN and carrier-consistency screens; no persistent coordinate-free contradiction remains.
classification_rules.PHYSICAL_WHCKL_LANE_UNQUALIFIED: Lane P fails a material essential physical gate while Lane T's assigned gates pass.
classification_rules.TANGENT_LANE_UNQUALIFIED: Lane P passes and Lane T fails tangent/MEGNO/LCN or carrier-consistency gates.
classification_rules.BOTH_LANES_UNQUALIFIED: Both lanes fail material assigned gates.
classification_rules.MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: An essential metric is unavailable, a required threshold lacks preregistered support, or multiple classifications remain comparably supported.
classification_rules.pass_scope: A pass supports the two-lane architecture only. It does not validate 0.25 day, authorize 100 kyr, authorize Stage 4, or authorize 10 Myr.

restart_contract.branch: Restore, verify serialized configuration and is_synchronized, reattach the same callback and flags, integrate exactly 146100 full steps to 1100 years, and compare with the main-lane 1100-year sample.

required_per_sample: live is_synchronized kernel coordinates correctors safe_mode keep_unsynchronized
all Lane T first-variation positions velocities
Lane T MEGNO and finite-time LCN
schema version lane id artifact id configuration fingerprint
telemetry_contract.partial_files: CSV telemetry is written to .partial files with fsync; final names appear only by atomic rename after complete validation.
telemetry_contract.sidecars: Status and checkpoint identity JSON are written atomically.
telemetry_contract.live_map_check: Record is_synchronized before and after sampling and require no change.

artifact_requirements.raw_policy: Raw lane trajectories, archives, operational sidecars, logs, and scratch arrays remain ignored under output_root.

forbidden_operations: physical model force Jacobian oracle dependency or historical artifact modification
production validation Stage 4 tag or 10 Myr command/run
